scope: Actual production editor with synthetic test projects/documents, IndexedDB and isolated persistence/AI response APIs. No live provider, real account or physical device.

results.name: Create two real test projects and distinct documents through editor controls
Immediate type/switch flushes final characters; slow save remains pending; current draft stays visible
Active/paused switches preserve session IDs, document attribution, counts and paused time
Failed autosave keeps the original project/body; retry persists it before switching
Failed project metadata sync preserves the current document and retries the existing queue
Slow cold load keeps the old label/body until ready; ready typing works during the fade
Failed document load does not commit a new project; retry opens the intact target
An uncached offline target cannot replace the current project or draft; online retry succeeds
Switch defaults to Current Project, resets consent/results, updates goals/library, and sends only explicit scoped AI payload
Cached offline switching protects local edits and reconnect synchronizes documents/preferences
Rapid attempts are disabled while pending; successive committed switches are deterministic and never move documents
Long documents, 320–1440px layouts, picker keyboard navigation, focus return and axe WCAG checks
Mobile touch selection, dark portaled menu, active marker and Spanish keyboard selection
Reduced-motion switching retains functionality without a document/picker animation
Completed documents remain closed; reload restores the correct project, unfinished writing and session history
